documentation.description: Fast open typed-decision profile for text decisions; noul/choice/score answers with probabilities in milliseconds. An alias for the current Fast version (see model_version in every response and the S1-Model-Version header). s1-fast-1 is retired: requests for it are answered by s1-fast-2, and inputs s1-fast-2 cannot take are refused with HTTP 400.
documentation.input_format: POST /v1/decide: state (at most 16 KiB serialized JSON) and exactly one boolean/noul, choice or score question. The model's input-token limit also applies. No streaming.
documentation.output_format: Verified answers and probabilities, with inputTokens usage. Input-only billing; output tokens are free. The EU route cannot fall back to Global.
documentation.example_input: {"model": "decisionmodelsio-eu/s1-fast", "state": "Mia owns a red bicycle.", "questions": {"color": {"type": "choice", "instructions": "Which color is the bicycle?", "criteria": {"red": null, "blue": null}}}}

documentation.description: Larger open typed-decision profile for text decisions; noul/choice/score answers with probabilities. An alias for the current Pro version: since 12 October 2026 s1-pro-3, based on vLLM-SR d3 26B (Apache-2.0), served in FP8 (see model_version in every response and the S1-Model-Version header). Pin s1-pro-3, or s1-pro-2 (the previous version, Perplexity Decider v1.1, available until at least 11 November 2026), to stay on one version. Text only; up to 3 questions per request, at most 8,192 input tokens per question including the state.
documentation.input_format: POST /v1/decide: state (at most 16 KiB serialized JSON) and exactly one boolean/noul, choice or score question. The model's input-token limit also applies. No streaming.
documentation.output_format: Verified answers and probabilities, with inputTokens usage. Input-only billing; output tokens are free. The EU route cannot fall back to Global.
documentation.example_input: {"model": "decisionmodelsio-eu/s1-pro", "state": "Mia owns a red bicycle.", "questions": {"color": {"type": "choice", "instructions": "Which color is the bicycle?", "criteria": {"red": null, "blue": null}}}}

documentation.description: REAX 1: open 27B typed-decision model by Decision Models (Apache-2.0); noul/choice/score answers with probabilities. Text only; up to 3 questions per request, each answered separately, with at most 8,192 input tokens per question including the state. Billed at the s1-pro price. `reax-1` always points to the current REAX 1 release. We may replace the model behind this id with a newer REAX version at any time, with the same API and price; we switch only to a version that measures at least as well on our evaluations. For reproducibility, pin a dated id such as `reax-1-20261021`; pinned ids stay available for at least 30 days after they stop being current.
documentation.input_format: POST /v1/decide: state (at most 16 KiB serialized JSON) and exactly one boolean/noul, choice or score question. The model's input-token limit also applies. No streaming. This model is not currently routable through TrustedRouter: decision-model-namespace-unsupported.
